Volume 55 is the 55th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga. It is both the fourth and final volume in the and the first of the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In both VIZ Media’s English and Panini Comics’ German translations, this volume is published as volume four of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Black 2 & White 2", which leave out the first chapters of the .
plainText:
Volume 55 is the 55th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga. It is both the fourth and final volume in the and the first of the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In both VIZ Media’s English and Panini Comics’ German translations, this volume is published as volume four of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Black 2 & White 2", which leave out the first chapters of the .

==Blurb==
It’s the exciting final volume of the Black 2 & White 2 arc! Blake catches up to Colress, the current leader of Team Plasma, while Whitley, accompanied by the reformed Team Plasma member N, corners Ghetsis, whose plan is to self-destruct, destroying everything around him. Both Trainers must defeat their enemies and save the world, but it won’t be easy.

Can the four Pokédex holders—Blake, Whitley, Black and White—handle the greatest crisis ever to hit the Unova region?!

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 547 - The Final Battle
Chapter 548 - Epilogue
Chapter 549 - An X-cuse to Come Out and Play 
Chapter 550 - X-actly What They Wanted 
Chapter 551 - Inn-teresting Developments 
Chapter 552 - They Have a Flare for a Li'l Kanga-Napping 

 
==Trivia==
In and , this volume was skipped, with its 's chapters published on and its 's chapters on .

==Translation edits==
The cover art for this volume was changed from the original in both VIZ Media’s English and Panini Comics’ German translations. Due to the removal of the X & Y arc's chapters from these releases of this volume, the original cover art design which was based on the latter arc was instead replaced with one that represents the Black 2 & White 2 arc.
